note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; no real text, section, hierarchy or definition is referenced. The hierarchy is a user-supplied ordering and implies no rule of precedence.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: A fictional article (Level 3) uses a term; the reader opens the full text at the flag of Level 2, where the definitions section supplies the definition, and pins a cord from the term to that entry.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: four user-supplied levels; the definition is supplied in a section at the last level (a lower flag, first row of the page) and the article sits at Level 1. The hands open the book at a different flag and the cord runs to a different row. Final state: definition located only (the book is opened, no link is made).
